title: Pure Gaia
summary: Pure Gaia and Curse of Dragon OTK/control build, pairing Yugi Muto's Warrior and Dragon duo with Artillery Catapult Turtle and staples. By assembling a Gaia the Fierce Knight monster and a Level 5 Dragon with Spiral Fusion, the deck fields 5200 ATK Dragon Champion Fusions that attack monsters twice and lock out opponent Battle Phase effects under Galloping Gaia.

summary.title: Starters
points: Artillery Catapult Turtle tributes itself to Special Summon any Gaia the Fierce Knight monster or Level 5 Dragon monster directly from the hand or Deck.
Galloping Gaia reveals a Gaia the Fierce Knight monster in hand to search a Level 5 Dragon (Curse of Dragon, the Cursed Dragon), or reveals a Level 5 Dragon to search a Gaia monster.
Gateway to Chaos (and Terraforming) searches a Gaia the Fierce Knight monster on activation, while Reinforcement of the Army searches Gaia the Magical Knight or Gaia the Fierce Knight Origin.

summary.title: Opening: Galloping Gaia + Either Half
steps: Activate Galloping Gaia and reveal Gaia the Magical Knight (or Curse of Dragon, the Cursed Dragon) in your hand to search the missing partner.

Normal Summon Gaia the Magical Knight without Tributing (allowed when you control no monsters or the opponent controls a 2300+ ATK monster) and use its on-summon effect to Special Summon Curse of Dragon, the Cursed Dragon from your hand or GY.
Curse of Dragon triggers on Special Summon to search Spiral Fusion from the Deck.
Activate Spiral Fusion to fuse both monsters into Gaia the Magical Knight of Dragons (or Sky Galloping Gaia the Dragon Champion) at 5200 ATK with 2 attacks on monsters.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Gaia the Magical Knight of Dragons is treated as Gaia the Dragon Champion; during the Main Phase, it can lose 2600 ATK as a Quick Effect to destroy any card on the field, then regains 2600 ATK whenever it destroys an opponent's monster by battle.
Sky Galloping Gaia the Dragon Champion searches Spiral Spear Strike from the Deck or GY on summon and changes an opponent's monster's battle position when it declares an attack.

Curse of Dragon, the Magical Knight Dragon recycles a Spell/Trap mentioning Gaia the Dragon Champion from the GY on Fusion Summon and lets you banish materials from your GY to Fusion Summon a Level 7 Dragon Fusion Monster.

Soldier Gaia the Fierce Knight tributes a Dragon Fusion Monster as a Quick Effect to Special Summon itself (dodging removal or squeezing in extra damage during the Battle Phase) and switches an Attack Position monster to Defense Position.
Gaia Dragon, the Thunder Charger overlays directly onto a Level 7 Gaia Fusion Monster that has spent its ATK to pop cards, restoring a 2600 ATK piercing body.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Galloping Gaia prevents the opponent from activating any card or effect during the Battle Phase while a Gaia the Dragon Champion is in your Monster Zone.

Spiral Spear Strike grants piercing battle damage to Gaia the Dragon Champion and draws 2 cards (then discards 1) each time it inflicts piercing damage; Gaia the Fierce Knight Origin can banish itself from the GY during the Battle Phase to reset a boosted fusion's ATK back to 2600.

Spiral Reborn revives a Level 7 or lower Dragon or Gaia the Dragon Champion with targeting and destruction immunity, while Spiral Discharge prevents targeting of Gaia the Dragon Champion and pops a card when it attacks a monster.

allow.Artillery Catapult Turtle: Tributes itself to Special Summon any 'Gaia the Fierce Knight' monster or Level 5 Dragon monster directly from the hand or Deck.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Gaia the Magical Knight.
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Gateway to Chaos.

main: Gaia the Magical Knight
Level 7 Warrior treated as 'Gaia the Fierce Knight' that Normal Summons without Tributing and Special Summons a Level 5 Dragon from hand or GY.
Soldier Gaia the Fierce Knight
Tributes a Dragon Fusion Monster as a Quick Effect to Special Summon itself and switches an Attack Position monster to Defense Position.
Gaia the Fierce Knight Origin
Special Summons itself by sending 1 Level 5 or higher monster from hand to GY and can serve as 2 Tributes for a Warrior.
Charging Gaia the Fierce Knight
Can be Normal Summoned without Tributing as a 1900 ATK monster and searches a Black Luster Soldier or provides an extra Gaia name.
Curse of Dragon, the Cursed Dragon
Level 5 Dragon that searches Spiral Fusion or any Spell/Trap mentioning Gaia the Dragon Champion on Normal or Special Summon.
Artillery Catapult Turtle
One-card starter that tributes itself to summon Gaia the Magical Knight or Curse of Dragon, the Cursed Dragon from the Deck.
Galloping Gaia
Continuous Spell that reveals Gaia to search a Level 5 Dragon (or vice versa) and prevents the opponent from activating effects during the Battle Phase.
Gateway to Chaos
Field Spell that searches a 'Gaia the Fierce Knight' monster on activation and removes 3 counters to search a Ritual/Fusion piece.
Spiral Fusion
Fuses a Dragon Fusion Monster from hand/field and gives 'Gaia the Dragon Champion' +2600 ATK and 2 attacks on monsters.
Spiral Spear Strike
Grants piercing battle damage to Gaia the Dragon Champion and draws 2 cards (discarding 1) when it inflicts piercing damage.
Spiral Reborn
Revives a Level 7 or lower Dragon or Gaia the Dragon Champion and grants targeting/destruction immunity.
Spiral Discharge
Protects Gaia the Dragon Champion from targeting and destroys 1 card on the field when it attacks a monster.
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Gaia the Magical Knight or Gaia the Fierce Knight Origin.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Gateway to Chaos.

Sky Galloping Gaia the Dragon Champion
